review_evidence: Reviewed all eight primary lean-inf files. The project implements arithmetic with infinities and infinitesimals using a Lean representation of the Levi-Civita field rather than merely providing presentation or repository tooling.

The hydrated source contains 150 declaration-style items across series/field/calculator infrastructure and explicit proved lemmas such as Array functor compatibility; the central infinitesimal arithmetic constructions are mathematically meaningful prior art.
Whole-source retirement would discard the formal representation and computational algebra of the Levi-Civita field, so the unit remains retained.
summary: Reviewed lean-inf and retain its Levi-Civita-field/infinite-infinitesimal arithmetic constructions as mathematical formal prior art.
